title: Downregulation of DNMT3a expression by RNAi and its effect on NF-kappaBs expression of thymic epithelial cells.
authors: Meng, Fan-Jie; Guo, Feng; Sun, Zhao-Nan; Wang, Shu-Jun; Yang, Chun-Rui; Wang, Chun-Yang; Zhang, Wen-Cheng; Gao, Zhou-Yong; Ji, Lin-Lin; Feng, Fu-Kai; Guan, Zhi-Yu; Wang, Guang-Shun
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNAi下调DNMT3a研究其对胸腺上皮细胞NF-kB表达的影响，属于基因表达调控与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To understand the characteristics of DNA methyltransferase 3a (DNMT3a) in thymoma associated Myasthenia Gravis reveal its transcriptional regulator network as while as analyze the effect of DNMT3a on Rel/ nuclear factor-kappaB family (RelA/RelB) and its downstream autoimmune regulatory factor (Aire). METHODS: Tissues of 30 patients with thymoma, with or without myasthenia gravis (MG), were collected and the DNMT3a protein expression were evaluated through immunohistochemistry. We performed mRNA expression profiling microarray detection and analysis, and integrated the analysis by constructing protein-protein interaction networks and the integration with other database. We identified molecular difference between low and high DNMT3a in the thymoma by heatmap. We also performed PCR validation in thymoma tissues. The DNMT3a-shRNA plasmid was transfected into TEC cells, and these cells were treated with 5-aza-2-deoxycytidine, a blocker of DNMT3a. After the down-regulation of DNMT3a in TEC cells, the transcript and protein levels of RelA, RelB, Aire, and CHRNA3 were evaluated by western blotting. In addition, changes in gene expression profiles were screened through microarray technology. We performed differential gene analysis in the thymoma cohort by heatmap with R (v.4.3.0) software. RESULTS: In 30 matched tissue specimens, the expression of DNMT3a protein in thymoma with MG was lower than that in thymoma. Through mRNA expression profiling analysis, we constructed a co-expression network of DNMT3a and found direct interaction between IKZF1 and DNMT3a, and this co-expression relationship was overlappted with Cistrome DB database. We found up-regulation of 149 mRNAs and repression of 177 mRNAs in thymoma with MG compared with thymoma. Gene ontology and pathway analysis show the involvement of a multitude of genes in the mis-regulation of MG-related pathways. RNA interference significantly reduced the level of mRNA of DNMT3a, which proved that plasmid DNMT3a was effective. In comparison to the control group, the levels of DNMT3a, Aire, and CHRNA3 mRNA and protein in TEC cells transfected with DNMT3a-shRNA interference plasmid were significantly decreased, while the expression level of RelA and RelA/RelB was significantly increased. CONCLUSIONS: Our study reveals the DNMT3a-NF-kappaB pathway has a major effect on MG, and can be used as a marker for diagnosis as well as a target for MG treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：了解DNA甲基转移酶3a（DNMT3a）在胸腺瘤相关重症肌无力中的特征，揭示其转录调控网络，并分析DNMT3a对Rel/核因子-κB家族（RelA/RelB）及其下游自身免疫调节因子（Aire）的影响。方法：收集30例伴有或不伴有重症肌无力（MG）的胸腺瘤患者组织，通过免疫组织化学评估DNMT3a蛋白表达。我们进行了mRNA表达谱微阵列检测与分析，并通过构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络及与其他数据库整合进行综合分析。我们通过热图识别了胸腺瘤中DNMT3a低表达与高表达之间的分子差异。我们还在胸腺瘤组织中进行了PCR验证。将DNMT3a-shRNA质粒转染至TEC细胞，并用DNMT3a阻断剂5-氮杂-2-脱氧胞苷处理这些细胞。在TEC细胞中下调DNMT3a后，通过western blotting评估RelA、RelB、Aire和CHRNA3的转录及蛋白水平。此外，通过微阵列技术筛选基因表达谱的变化。我们使用R（v.4.3.0）软件通过热图对胸腺瘤队列进行差异基因分析。结果：在30例匹配的组织标本中，伴有MG的胸腺瘤中DNMT3a蛋白表达低于单纯胸腺瘤。通过mRNA表达谱分析，我们构建了DNMT3a的共表达网络，发现IKZF1与DNMT3a之间存在直接相互作用，且该共表达关系与Cistrome DB数据库重叠。我们发现，与单纯胸腺瘤相比，伴有MG的胸腺瘤中有149个mRNA上调，177个mRNA下调。基因本体论和通路分析显示，众多基因参与MG相关通路的失调。RNA干扰显著降低了DNMT3a的mRNA水平，证明质粒DNMT3a有效。与对照组相比，转染DNMT3a-shRNA干扰质粒的TEC细胞中DNMT3a、Aire和CHRNA3的mRNA及蛋白水平显著降低，而RelA和RelA/RelB的表达水平显著升高。结论：我们的研究揭示DNMT3a-NF-κB通路对MG具有重要影响，可作为诊断标志物及MG治疗靶点。
